title: DF-Story Teller
description: Turning Dwarf Fortress worlds into stories. Legends data, live events and DFHack integration come together to generate narratives grounded in the world you're playing.

title: AI Game Assistant
description: A hands-free companion for in-game lore. Combines OCR, voice commands and save-file analysis to answer questions with context and help avoid spoilers.

title: DF-Portrait
description: Recreating Dwarf Fortress character portraits from DFHack data by reverse engineering the game's sprite compositor. Developed for DF-Story Teller, then made standalone and open source.

title: Home Assistant + Cloudflare
description: Remote home automation through a Cloudflare Tunnel, with Zero Trust access controls around a self-hosted Home Assistant instance.

title: Personal Portfolio
description: A lightweight home for my work, built with HTML, CSS and JavaScript. Originally self-hosted through a Cloudflare Tunnel; now served by GitHub Pages.
